The name 'Shemvansh' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shoma', which was the name of the goddess of fertility and agriculture worshipped by the early rulers of the Shemvansh Dynasty. The dynasty's name is believed to have originated from the goddess's name, reflecting the importance of agriculture and fertility in the region during that time.
